# UDreamPanelSlot

<!-- Generated by the DreamGUIReferenceDocs commandlet from reflection. Edit the header, not this page. -->

Inherits from `UDreamWidgetSubObjectBehaviour`.

Declared in `Public/Core/Components/DreamPanelSlot.h`.

UMG-style per-child layout data owned by the child widget.

| `ZOrder` | `int32` | Slot | yes | `SetZOrder` | Paint order among siblings, applied as a stable reorder (equal values keep sibling order). Consumed by Overlay and GridPanel always, and by CanvasPanel when SortChildrenByZOrder is on; every other panel arranges strictly by sibling order and ignores this value. |
| `bAutoSize` | `bool` | Slot | yes | `SetAutoSize` |  |
| `MinDesiredSize` | `FVector2D` | Slot | yes | `SetMinDesiredSize` | Floor and ceiling applied to whatever this child measures, per axis, zero meaning "no opinion". |
| `MaxDesiredSize` | `FVector2D` | Slot | yes | `SetMaxDesiredSize` |  |
| `bFillEmptySpace` | `bool` | Slot | yes | `SetFillEmptySpace` | WrapBox only, matching UMG's UWrapBoxSlot: share out whatever room is left over on this child's line among the children on it that asked for it. Read by no other panel. |
| `FillSpanWhenLessThan` | `float` | Slot | yes | `SetFillSpanWhenLessThan` | WrapBox only, matching UMG's UWrapBoxSlot: when the box's wrap width drops below this, give this child a line to itself. Zero disables it. The classic use is a responsive list of cards that stops sharing rows once the panel is narrow enough that sharing would make everything unreadable. |
| `bForceNewLine` | `bool` | Slot | yes | `SetNewLine` | WrapBox only, matching UMG's UWrapBoxSlot::bForceNewLine: begin a line at this child however much room is left on the current one. The unconditional twin of FillSpanWhenLessThan, which only breaks once the box is narrow; this is how a section heading stays at the head of its own row. |
| `Nudge` | `FVector2D` | Slot | yes | `SetNudge` | A fixed offset added to wherever the panel decided to put this child, in the panel's content space (x right, y down -- the same sense as Padding). |
